description: Submete uma attestation ZK-verified no compliance-registry (create_verified_attestation). Faz CPI ao SP1 verifier program antes de gravar. commitmentHex deve equalar a subject_commitment (bytes[32..64] do publicInputs). Requer proof SP1 v6 (356 bytes) + public_inputs (96 bytes).

commitmentHex.description: 32 bytes hex (deve bater com bytes[32..64] do publicInputs).

name: submit_verified_compliance_attestation
